standards.source: Gurvich et al., Thermodynamic Properties of Individual Substances, Volume IV, Table 2026

rows.name: NiO dilute-solute activity

reported_spread.interpretation: Reported plus/minus spread; not identified as a standard error.

range_flags: Provisional transfer from the measured metal-saturated silicate-melt composition family to regolith-like melts.
The source abstract does not specify a numerical upper mole-fraction limit for dilute NiO.
Outside the reported temperature, oxygen-fugacity, FeO, or MgO intervals the central value is an extrapolation.

construction.premise: Holzheid, Palme, and Chakraborty report a mean gamma_NiO(l) of 2.70 +/- 0.52 from 77 experiments, relative to pure liquid NiO and simple oxide mole fractions.
construction.algebra: For dilute NiO, a_NiO = gamma_NiO(l) * x_NiO; no parameter is fitted to battery rows.
construction.units_check: gamma_NiO(l), x_NiO, and a_NiO are dimensionless.

provenance.source: Holzheid, A.; Palme, H.; Chakraborty, S. (1997), The activities of NiO, CoO and FeO in silicate melts.
provenance.source_locator: Chemical Geology 139, pp. 21-38; abstract reports gamma_NiO(l), its spread, 77 experiments, and the stated temperature, fO2, FeO, and MgO limits.
provenance.selection_rationale: The measured coefficient uses the same pure-liquid NiO standard as the existing gas parent row and is independent of the simulator battery.

independent_check.reason: The reported activity experiments define this helper's central coefficient; no separate same-standard Ni activity set is used as a held-out check.

flags.description: Opt-in NiO activity estimate with reported source-domain checks and provisional composition transfer.
